query:
SELECT GREATEST(
            (SELECT COALESCE(sum(play_count), 0) FROM scrobbles_daily_by_track
             WHERE track_id = $2 AND user_id = $1)
          - (SELECT count(*) FROM scrobble_flags
             WHERE track_id = $2 AND user_id = $1 AND status = 'duplicate'),
            0)::bigint AS "plays!"
